local categories = {}
Core.CATEGORY_NAMES = { "All words" }
for i = 1, #CATEGORY_DATA do
	local entry = CATEGORY_DATA[i]
	local seen, list = {}, {}
	for w in string.gmatch(entry[2], "%a+") do
		w = string.lower(w)
		if not seen[w] then
			seen[w] = true
			list[#list + 1] = w
		end
	end
	table.sort(list)
	categories[i] = list
	Core.CATEGORY_NAMES[i + 1] = entry[1]
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- Helpers
local function copy(t)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #t do out[i] = t[i] end
	return out
end

-- first index whose word is >= target
local function lowerBound(target)
	local lo, hi = 1, wordCount + 1
	while lo < hi do
		local mid = math.floor((lo + hi) / 2)
		if words[mid] < target then
			lo = mid + 1
		else
			hi = mid
		end
	end
	return lo
end

-- how many dictionary words start with s ("{" sorts right after "z")
local function countStarting(s)
	return lowerBound(s .. "{") - lowerBound(s)
end

local function inDict(w)
	return words[lowerBound(w)] == w
end

local SCRABBLE = {}
for letters, pts in pairs({
	aeilnorstu = 1, dg = 2, bcmp = 3, fhvwy = 4, k = 5, jx = 8, qz = 10,
}) do
	for i = 1, #letters do SCRABBLE[string.byte(letters, i)] = pts end
end

local function scrabbleScore(w)
	local s = 0
	for i = 1, #w do s = s + (SCRABBLE[string.byte(w, i)] or 0) end
	return s
end

local seenMark, seenGen = {}, 0
local function uniqueLetters(w)
	seenGen = seenGen + 1
	local c = 0
	for i = 1, #w do
		local b = string.byte(w, i)
		if seenMark[b] ~= seenGen then
			seenMark[b] = seenGen
			c = c + 1
		end
	end
	return c
end

local chainCache = {}
-- how many words could follow w, if the next word must start with w's last `ending` letters
local function chainCount(w, ending, fromDict)
	local s = string.sub(w, -ending)
	local c = chainCache[s]
	if not c then
		c = countStarting(s)
		chainCache[s] = c
	end
	-- don't count the word itself (you can't reuse it)
	if string.sub(w, 1, #s) == s and (fromDict or inDict(w)) then
		c = c - 1
	end
	return c
end
Core.chainCount = function(w, ending) return chainCount(w, ending, false) end

---------------------------------------------------------------- Loading
-- getPart(i) returns the compressed text of part i
function Core.load(getPart, partCount, onProgress)
	local n, prev = 0, ""
	words = {}
	for i = 1, partCount do
		local data = getPart(i)
		-- each entry: one char (shared prefix length + 48) followed by the rest of the word
		for p, suffix in string.gmatch(data, "([^a-z])([a-z]+)") do
			local w = string.sub(prev, 1, string.byte(p) - 48) .. suffix
			n = n + 1
			words[n] = w
			prev = w
		end
		if onProgress then onProgress(i / partCount) end
		task.wait()
	end
	wordCount = n
	loaded = true
	return n
end

function Core.isLoaded() return loaded end
function Core.count() return wordCount end
function Core.word(i) return words[i] end

---------------------------------------------------------------- Searching
local function gather(source, fromDict, q, mode, isStale)
	if q == "" then
		return copy(source)
	end
	if mode == 1 and fromDict then
		local first, last = lowerBound(q), lowerBound(q .. "{") - 1
		return table.move(words, first, last, 1, {})
	end
	local out, n, len = {}, 0, #q
	for i = 1, #source do
		local w = source[i]
		local ok
		if mode == 1 then
			ok = string.sub(w, 1, len) == q
		elseif mode == 2 then
			ok = string.sub(w, -len) == q
		else
			ok = string.find(w, q, 1, true) ~= nil
		end
		if ok then
			n = n + 1
			out[n] = w
		end
		if i % 25000 == 0 then
			task.wait()
			if isStale() then return nil end
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- Group words by an integer key and take the first `limit` in key order.
-- Words keep their A-Z order within each key, so no big table.sort is needed.
local function topByKey(list, keyFn, descending, filter, limit, isStale)
	local buckets, keys, total = {}, {}, 0
	for i = 1, #list do
		local w = list[i]
		local k = keyFn(w)
		if not filter or filter(k) then
			total = total + 1
			local b = buckets[k]
			if not b then
				b = {}
				buckets[k] = b
				keys[#keys + 1] = k
			end
			b[#b + 1] = w
		end
		if i % 20000 == 0 then
			task.wait()
			if isStale() then return nil end
		end
	end
	if descending then
		table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return a > b end)
	else
		table.sort(keys)
	end
	local out, outKeys = {}, {}
	for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
		local b = buckets[k]
		for j = 1, #b do
			if #out >= limit then return out, outKeys, total end
			out[#out + 1] = b[j]
			outKeys[#out] = k
		end
	end
	return out, outKeys, total
end

--[[
	opts = { text, mode (1-3), category (0 = all words), sort (1-10), ending (1-4), limit }
	returns { status = "ok" | "loading" | "empty", words, keys, total, showKeys }
	or nil if a newer search replaced this one.
]]
function Core.query(opts, isStale)
	isStale = isStale or function() return false end
	if not loaded then return { status = "loading" } end

	local q = (string.gsub(string.lower(opts.text or ""), "[^a-z]", ""))
	local category = opts.category or 0
	if q == "" and category == 0 then
		return { status = "empty" }
	end

	local source, fromDict = words, true
	if category > 0 then
		source, fromDict = categories[category], false
	end

	local list = gather(source, fromDict, q, opts.mode or 1, isStale)
	if not list then return nil end

	local limit = opts.limit or 400
	local sort = opts.sort or 1
	local ending = opts.ending or 1
	local S = Core.SORT
	local res = { status = "ok", query = q }

	if sort == S.AZ then
		res.words = table.move(list, 1, math.min(limit, #list), 1, {})
		res.total = #list
	elseif sort == S.ZA then
		local out = {}
		for i = #list, math.max(1, #list - limit + 1), -1 do out[#out + 1] = list[i] end
		res.words, res.total = out, #list
	elseif sort == S.RANDOM then
		local n = #list
		for i = 1, math.min(limit, n) do
			local j = math.random(i, n)
			list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
		end
		res.words = table.move(list, 1, math.min(limit, n), 1, {})
		res.total = n
	else
		local keyFn, descending, filter
		if sort == S.SHORT or sort == S.LONG then
			keyFn = function(w) return #w end
			descending = (sort == S.LONG)
		elseif sort == S.SCRABBLE then
			keyFn, descending, res.showKeys = scrabbleScore, true, true
		elseif sort == S.UNIQUE then
			keyFn, descending, res.showKeys = uniqueLetters, true, true
		else
			keyFn = function(w) return chainCount(w, ending, fromDict) end
			res.chains = true
			if sort == S.FEWEST_CHAINS then
				filter = function(k) return k > 0 end
				res.showKeys = true
			elseif sort == S.MOST_CHAINS then
				descending, res.showKeys = true, true
			else -- dead ends
				filter = function(k) return k == 0 end
			end
		end
		local out, keys, total = topByKey(list, keyFn, descending, filter, limit, isStale)
		if not out then return nil end
		res.words, res.keys, res.total = out, keys, total
	end
	return res
end

return Core
end)()

local function make(class, props, parent)
	local inst = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
	inst.Parent = parent
	return inst
end

local function corner(parent, r)
	make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 6) }, parent)
end

local function button(text, pos, size, parent)
	local b = make("TextButton", {
		Position = pos, Size = size, Text = text, AutoButtonColor = true,
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.field, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
	}, parent)
	corner(b, 6)
	return b
end

	BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", TextWrapped = true,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
	Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
}, scroll)

---------------------------------------------------------------- Dropdown
local blocker = make("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "",
	Visible = false, ZIndex = 10, AutoButtonColor = false,
}, frame)

local popup = make("ScrollingFrame", {
	BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.bar, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 4,
	CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
	Visible = false, ZIndex = 11,
}, frame)
corner(popup, 6)

local function closePopup()
	popup.Visible = false
	blocker.Visible = false
end
blocker.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closePopup)

local function openDropdown(anchor, options, selected, onPick)
	for _, child in ipairs(popup:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiButton") or child:IsA("UIListLayout") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	make("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, popup)
	for i, text in ipairs(options) do
		local b = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 12,
			BackgroundColor3 = (i == selected) and COLORS.accent or COLORS.bar,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "  " .. text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
		}, popup)
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			closePopup()
			onPick(i)
		end)
	end
	local rel = anchor.AbsolutePosition - frame.AbsolutePosition
	local width = math.max(anchor.AbsoluteSize.X, 190)
	local x = math.min(rel.X, frame.AbsoluteSize.X - width - 6)
	local y = rel.Y + anchor.AbsoluteSize.Y + 2
	local height = math.min(#options * 26, frame.AbsoluteSize.Y - y - 6)
	popup.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
	popup.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
	popup.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
	blocker.Visible = true
	popup.Visible = true
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- Dragging
local dragging, dragStart, startPos, endConn = false, nil, nil, nil

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = frame.Position
		if endConn then endConn:Disconnect() end
		endConn = input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
				if endConn then endConn:Disconnect() endConn = nil end
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		frame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

local minimized = false
minButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	minimized = not minimized
	closePopup()
	frame.Size = minimized and MIN_SIZE or FULL_SIZE
	minButton.Text = minimized and "+" or "–"
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------- Search
local requestId = 0

local function formatNumber(n)
	local s = tostring(n)
	return (s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", ""))
end

local function refresh(debounce)
	requestId += 1
	local myId = requestId
	local function stale() return myId ~= requestId end

	if debounce then
		task.wait(0.15)
		if stale() then return end
	end

	if not Core.isLoaded() then return end
	status.Text = "Searching..."

	local res = Core.query({
		text = box.Text, mode = state.mode, category = state.category,
		sort = state.sort, ending = state.ending, limit = MAX_RESULTS,
	}, stale)
	if res == nil or stale() then return end

	scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
	if res.status == "empty" then
		status.Text = "Type letters or pick a category"
		results.Text = ""
		return
	end
	if res.total == 0 then
		status.Text = "No matches"
		results.Text = ""
		return
	end

	local info = formatNumber(res.total) .. " match" .. (res.total == 1 and "" or "es")
	if res.total > #res.words then
		info ..= " · showing " .. #res.words
	end
	if res.chains then
		info ..= (" · next word starts with last %d letter%s"):format(state.ending, state.ending == 1 and "" or "s")
	end
	status.Text = info

	local parts = table.create(#res.words)
	for i, w in ipairs(res.words) do
		if res.showKeys then
			parts[i] = ("%s (%d)"):format(w, res.keys[i])
		else
			parts[i] = w
		end
	end
	results.Text = table.concat(parts, "   ")
end

local function updateButtons()
	modeBtn.Text = Core.MODES[state.mode] .. " ▾"
	catBtn.Text = Core.CATEGORY_NAMES[state.category + 1] .. " ▾"
	sortBtn.Text = Core.SORTS[state.sort] .. " ▾"
	for i, b in ipairs(endButtons) do
		b.BackgroundColor3 = (i == state.ending) and COLORS.accent or COLORS.field
	end
end

modeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	openDropdown(modeBtn, Core.MODES, state.mode, function(i)
		state.mode = i
		updateButtons()
		refresh()
	end)
end)

catBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	openDropdown(catBtn, Core.CATEGORY_NAMES, state.category + 1, function(i)
		state.category = i - 1
		updateButtons()
		refresh()
	end)
end)

sortBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	openDropdown(sortBtn, Core.SORTS, state.sort, function(i)
		state.sort = i
		updateButtons()
		refresh()
	end)
end)

for i, b in ipairs(endButtons) do
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		state.ending = i
		updateButtons()
		refresh()
	end)
end

box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
	refresh(true)
end)

updateButtons()

---------------------------------------------------------------- Load dictionary
task.spawn(function()
	local count = Core.load(function(i)
		return DICTIONARY[i]
	end, PART_COUNT, function(fraction)
		status.Text = ("Loading dictionary... %d%%"):format(math.floor(fraction * 100))
	end)
	status.Text = formatNumber(count) .. " words loaded · type letters or pick a category"
	if box.Text ~= "" or state.category ~= 0 then refresh() end
end)
